title: PTP: cleanup of PTPv2
description:
Source Code Cleanup:
- Relative offset parsing for PTPv2 Headers
- Adding a couple of missing reserved fields
- Format cleanup of defines and Value Strings
- Removed unused defines
- Set 1 bytes header fields to ENC_NA
- Changed some reserved hfs to be lower case as in standards
- Changed PTPv2 header flags to use proto_tree_add_bitmask
